text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: It's time for lunch, and Fuji Kiseki and I are in the cafeteria looking at the menu for the day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I think I'll get an apple slice and… half an orange. Yes, that should be enough.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha… Well, I ate too much during dinner yesterday, and I don't want to overdo it again today.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: The truth is, my dear ponies have been cooking up a storm for me each night.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: After I accepted a meal from one of them, the whole dorm heard about it, and now I'm met with a nightly buffet of food.
choice_data_list: If you're struggling to eat everything, you should decline their offers.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: You're right, but… they pour their whole hearts into their cooking, and I don't want to let them down.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I understand where she's coming from, but it's still a problem if she's overeating on a daily basis…

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh, Fuji! I'm so glad I found you!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Oh, it's you. You're the one who made that delicious omelet rice last night, yes?

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That's right! I made it again today, and well… I was hoping to give it to you!
choice_data_list: Actually, I'm not so sure if that's…

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you! I can't believe I get to enjoy your omelet rice yet again. I must be the luckiest person in all of Tracen! ♪

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Aaah! Please, I should be the one thanking you!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: As I watch their exchange, I get the feeling Fuji Kiseki's charming graciousness is what made so many students start cooking for her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: See? Look how happy she is! It would be wrong to refuse such a generous offer.
choice_data_list: Fine, but only have one bite!
Fine, but only have one bite!
All right, all right. Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: See? Look how happy she is! It would be wrong to refuse such a generous offer.
choice_data_list: Fine, but only have one bite!
Fine, but only have one bite!
All right, all right. Go for it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you for understanding.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: As you can see, I'm under strict orders and can have but a single mouthful. I hope you don't mind, sweet pony.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: Oh no! Are you on a diet right now?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Unfortunately, I am. But worry not! I'll make sure to savor the taste of your cooking and commit it to memory. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: True to her word, Fuji Kiseki takes a spoonful of the omelet rice and relishes it as if it's pure ambrosia.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Thank you for respecting my feelings, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Why, I can't wait to taste—hm? This looks larger than the one you made last night.

text_block_list.name: Young Umamusume A
text_block_list.text: That's because it is! I loaded it up with all my love. I hope you like it!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Aha. No wonder your food is always so scrumptious. ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki tucks into the omelet rice and cleans her plate, much to the delight of her adoring fan.
